In the background, there are stacks of lumber, other machinery, and trees. The ground is dirt with scattered wood debris.

artifact_observations.location: Central sawmill carriage base and rails
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mechanical structure of the sawmill carriage lacks logical connectivity. The vertical supports seem to merge into the horizontal beams without clear bolts or joints. The 'rails' at the bottom appear to float or melt into the dirt rather than sitting firmly on a track bed.
The worker on the right has a slightly 'waxy' or smoothed texture typical of AI generation. The folds in the blue jumpsuit lack sharp definition and seem to blend into the background slightly.
The background elements have inconsistent scaling and perspective lines that don't fully align with the foreground machine, creating a slight sense of spatial disconnection.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the main yellow frame
artifact_observations.reasoning: The left vertical post of the sawmill seems to fuse with the background machinery/trees, lacking a clean boundary separation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of industrial equipment matches the 'lumbermill' class label despite the non-standard outdoor setting.
To verify if the machine sits logically on the ground plane and to detect any floating elements or depth bleeding between the machine and the background.
To audit the connectivity of the metal frame components and check for melting/fusion artifacts at the joints.
To assess general coherence, lighting consistency, and subtle texture anomalies in the worker and environment.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the sawmill carriage (joints, rails, supports)
Boundary separation between the machine and the background
Logical placement of the machine on the ground plane
Anatomical correctness of the human figure
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mechanical logic of the sawmill.
